pages.title: Traces underfoot
pages.text: Strange roots appear in the Forest of the Beyond: some quite small, others much larger.$(br2)They grow as if showing the way: one end is thicker and aims at the $(l:forest/titan_tree)Titan Tree$(/l), the other is thin.

pages.title: How to read them
pages.text: $(li)Walk from the thin end toward the thick one.$(li)The closer to the tree, the more often they appear.$(li)There are none within 14 blocks of a Mavka Tree.
